name: AppFlowy
title: AppFlowy: free Notion alternative
caption:
Notion Plus costs $120/year. AppFlowy organizes your notes, tasks and docs for free 📝

✅ Docs and wikis for notes and reports
✅ Databases with kanban boards for tasks and projects
✅ Built-in AI to summarize and ask your workspace
✅ Self-host it to keep control of your data

💻 Mac · Windows · Linux · iPhone · Android
ℹ️ The desktop app is free to download and use, but AppFlowy also sells paid cloud and AI plans, and Notion's $120/year is Plus at $10/month billed yearly

Comment "FLOW" and I'll DM you the link 🔗

dm_pitch: AppFlowy, the free open-source Notion alternative 📝

beats.say: Why is anyone still paying a hundred and twenty dollars a year for Notion?
There's a free app that does all of it.
Notion Plus costs ten bucks a month. AppFlowy costs nothing.
Plan projects on kanban boards, and drag tasks from to do to done.
Databases for your tasks, with owners, status and due dates.
It runs on Mac, Windows, Linux and your phone.
It's Notion, minus the monthly bill.
Comment Flow, and I'll send you the link.
